The '''Narvath sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]], [[Iktotchon/Legends|Iktotchon]] and [[Narvath]].
